Counsel for Respondent :- A.S.G.I.,C.S.C.,Gaurav Kumar Chand,Sunil Kumar Yadav
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Manish Kumar Nigam,J.
1.

The instant petition has been filed praying for a mandamus commanding respondent no. 5 i.e.
Special Land Acquisition Officer, Azamgarh to pay compensation to the petitioner in respect of Gata
No. 6695 which was acquired under the provisions of the National Highways Act, 1956.

2. According to the petitioner, an award was made on 23.2.2018 but the compensation amount has
not been released in favour of the petitioner so far.
3.  It is submitted that the petitioner has filed an application on 20.12.2022 before respondent no. 5 but the compensation has not been released in favour of the petitioner as yet.

sentences.text: Sri Gaurav Chand, learned counsel for respondent no.1 and Sri Sunil Kumat Yadav, learned counsel for respondent no. 3 submits that the name of the petitioner does not find place in Form-11.
They also points out that in the notification the said plot is described as 'Pokhar'.
It is thus sought to be contended that the petitioner is not entitled to any sum as compensation.
5. On the other hand, the petitioner places reliance on the sale deed and the entries in the consolidation records in contending that he was owner of the aforesaid land.

6. In our opinion, since the petitioner has already approached respondent no. 5 but no decision has been taken by him so far, therefore, interest of justice would be served in directing him to decide the representation dated 20.12.2022.

Accordingly, petition is disposed of with the direction to respondent no. 5 to decide the said representation by means of a speaking order within a period of 8 weeks from the date of receipt of true attested copy of the instant order aongwith photostat copy of the representation.
